about: P95 (8 Nov 2026): the outline library. Each outline is a file from an open icon set on GitHub, taken unchanged but for the background square a set adds (removed by kit/p95_library.py), because a course's texts discuss the object: "texts" lists, for each course it serves, every file whose text names it (its keywords) with the count. kit/relief.py turns each into <id>.json, which viz.py's kind "relief" draws. A caption prints "<depicts>, a stylised outline drawn as a relief from an icon. <credit>.", the licence linked; verify.py checks it is printed exactly. A count is of the prose: the front matter, a unit's Sources section, figure declarations, link targets and URLs are taken out first, and every sentence that holds one of the outline's "excludes" (a homonym, a title, another kind of the thing). licences/ holds each set's licence file at the commit taken.
